standard.summary: compatible=支持梯度累积的安全档；full=立即释放（更省显存，不兼容 accum/clip/fp16）；post_step=基线。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.compatible: 释放激进程度中等，大多数优化器都能用。
optionDescriptions.full: 放得更狠，显存更省，个别优化器/累加组合可能别扭。（本选择器里没有：与梯度累积、梯度裁剪、fp16 互斥，后端会按实际配置自动降级并把原因写进「梯度释放降级原因」，故不开放手选。）
optionDescriptions.post_step: step 完再放，省得最少，当对照。（本选择器里没有：它是后端自动降级的落点之一，由后端按优化器与并行配置决定，不由用户直接指定。）

standard_en.summary: compatible = the safe gear that supports gradient accumulation; full = frees immediately (saves more VRAM, incompatible with accum/clip/fp16); post_step = the baseline.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.compatible: Moderately aggressive freeing that works with most optimizers.
optionDescriptions.full: Frees harder and saves more VRAM, though a few optimizer and accumulation combinations get awkward. (Not in this selector: it is mutually exclusive with gradient accumulation, gradient clipping and fp16, so the backend downgrades automatically according to the actual config and writes the reason into the gradient-release downgrade reason. Hence it is not offered as a manual choice.)
optionDescriptions.post_step: Frees after the step: saves the least, and serves as the control. (Not in this selector: it is one of the landing points of the backend's automatic downgrade, decided by the backend from the optimizer and parallel configuration rather than specified by the user.)

advanced.principle: compatible=支持梯度累积的安全档；full=立即释放（更省显存，不兼容 accum/clip/fp16）；post_step=基线。

advanced_en.principle: compatible = safe tier that supports gradient accumulation; full = release immediately (saves more VRAM, incompatible with accum/clip/fp16); post_step = baseline.
